lines.description: Lines to show, from the top. Default 200.

markdown.description: Render as markdown. Default: true for .md and .markdown files.

path.description: File to show. `~/` is expanded; a relative path is read from the config file's folder.

root.text:
# Release notes

See [docs/plugins.md](docs/plugins.md) for the protocol.

entries.description: Shows a text or markdown file and shows it again when it changes. Good for a todo list or notes. TypeScript version of the built-in textfile module.
entries.name: Text file (TS)
